title: Pumpkin — Plant profile
subject: Pumpkin
summary: Pumpkin is a vegetable for warm season planting, originating in Americas. Needs: Full sun; rich soil; room. Big vines maturing in 85–90 days. Field: fruiting.

Note: Big vines maturing in 85–90 days.
